About the team
Our payments platform processes millions of UPI and card transactions a day for merchants across India.

Responsibilities
- Design and build microservices for the payments ledger
- Own services end to end, from design reviews to on-call
- Mentor junior engineers

Requirements
- 3-5 years of experience building backend systems
- Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and Microservices
- Experience deploying services on AWS
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Preferred
- Experience with Kafka

Nice to have
- Kubernetes

This is a hybrid role: 3 days a week in our Hyderabad office.
